02 / Additional history / context

03 / Associated symptoms

+ = present. − = explicitly denied, recorded under Patient denies (or attributed to the history source). Symptoms left unselected are omitted from the note. Review every symptom before copying.

04 / Examination — selected presentation

Tick observed findings or select an assessment. Blank and Not assessed are omitted from the note. Normal findings are recorded only when explicitly selected. Add side, site or measurements where needed. Consent/chaperone for intimate examinations.
